prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Learn how to summon, move, toggle visibility, and interact with your pet anytime on your screen.", "Control Guide", "Right-click pet for menu; Press hotkey to hide/show; Click to feed or talk."]
1: ["Preparing Your Pet & System Environment", "Setting up desktop overlay permissions and graphics rendering...", "System Check", "Desktop Overlay: Ready | Graphics Renderer: Initialized | Notification Permissions: Active"]
2: ["Find Your Ideal Pet Path", "Answer 2 quick questions to discover your best companion match.", "Preferred Style", "Guided Adventure vs Free Play Customization"]
3: ["Signing in secures your pet companion data across device restarts and app updates.", "Account Protection Active", "Your pet progress will be automatically saved to your account."]
4: ["Practice Controlling Your Companion", "Try the interactive buttons below to test hiding and summoning your pet right now.", "Test Hide / Show Pet", "Toggle pet visibility test", "Test Pet Voice", "Trigger test pet speech bubble"]
5: ["Ensure bright, direct lighting and clear subject framing for optimal AI pet generation results.", "Best Results Guide", "Good lighting: Yes | Clear face/body: Yes | No heavy shadows: Yes"]
6: ["Choose Your Companion Journey", "Select the path that best matches your onboarding preference.", "Path Options", "Quick Companion (2 min) | Guided Story (5 min) | Custom Pet Creation"]
7: []
8: ["Completion Sound Alert", "Play a friendly chime when your pet is ready on your desktop"]
9: ["Meet Your Future Desktop Companion", "Every pet has unique desk behaviors—some love idle animations, while others react to mouse clicks and typing.", "You can customize behaviors and sound settings anytime after setup."]
